vars.STYLE: Painted illustration matching the reference image's style exactly: realistic oil-painting look, soft morning light, muted greens and sandy ochres, fine brushwork. Landscape 3:2. No text, no letters, no logos, no signs, no arrows.
vars.YOU: ONE adult hiker (the viewer's stand-in): dark olive modern rain jacket, grey trousers, hiking boots, a rust-orange backpack, short dark hair, seen from behind or in profile so the face is NEVER visible
vars.HORSE: a Przewalski's horse with correct anatomy: stocky, short-legged, sandy dun coat, pale muzzle, dark lower legs, short dark mane standing straight up like a brush

map.prompt: Painted antique-style relief map of Europe and Asia, seen from above, warm parchment land with soft painted mountains and dark slate-blue seas, gentle vignette. Natural coastlines only: NO country borders, NO lines, NO text, NO labels, NO cities, NO symbols. The landmass spans the frame from Western Europe on the left to the Pacific coast on the right. Landscape 3:2, painterly brushwork.

you_road.prompt: {STYLE} An empty cracked asphalt road runs straight away from the camera between tall pine trees, with abandoned wooden village houses with collapsed roofs at the roadside. {YOU} walks away from the camera down the middle of the road, about one third of the frame height, slightly left of centre, mid-stride. Spring, quiet, nobody else.

barn.prompt: {STYLE} Close view of the open dark doorway of an old grey weathered wooden barn beside an overgrown village road. {HORSE} is just stepping out of the shadow of the doorway into the morning sunlight: its head and front legs are in the light, the rest of its body still in the dark barn. The horse faces three-quarters toward the camera. No people.

you_turn.prompt: {STYLE} The same hiker from the first reference image (same jacket, same rust-orange backpack) stands at the left edge of an overgrown village road in the foreground, seen from behind and slightly to the side, face not visible. In the middle distance on the road, {HORSE} stands side-on by an old wooden barn and has turned its head to look straight at the hiker. Pine trees, roofless houses, morning light.

two_shot.prompt: {STYLE} Thumbnail-style scale composition: {HORSE} fills the RIGHT 60% of the frame, large and close, standing on an empty overgrown road in front of an old abandoned barn, head turned toward the left. Far smaller on the LEFT, about one fifth in from the left edge, the same hiker as in the first reference image (same jacket, rust-orange backpack) stands side-on looking up at the horse, face not visible. Pines behind, soft morning light.

you_scale.prompt: {STYLE} Side view in a grassy clearing beside a quiet road in a pine forest: {HORSE} grazes, head down in the grass. The same hiker as in the first reference image (same jacket, rust-orange backpack) stands next to the horse's shoulder, seen from behind at three-quarters, face not visible. The horse's back is roughly level with the hiker's chest, showing it is pony-sized. Both full-figure, mid-frame. Soft morning light.

c01_walk.prompt: The hiker walks slowly away from the camera down the empty road at a calm pace; the camera follows gently behind at the same pace. Pine branches sway slightly in a light breeze.

c04_barn.prompt: The horse steps forward out of the barn doorway onto the dirt road, walking calmly toward the camera with natural head movement. Static camera.

c06_turn.prompt: The horse slowly turns its head further toward the hiker and pricks its ears forward. The hiker stands still. Very slow gentle camera push in.

c10_scale.prompt: The horse keeps grazing, pulling at the grass and shifting its weight, its tail swishing. The hiker stands still beside it. Slow sideways camera drift.

c13_pines.prompt: Slow smooth camera pull back, revealing more tall dark pine trunks around the small horse standing on the forest road. The horse flicks its tail and turns its head slightly.
